name: Mudsnout Mixture
summary: In the Undercity, Master Apothecary Faranell prepares a base for a deadly Forsaken poison. Mudsnout Mixture begins with mushrooms sent north from Tarren Mill.

sections.title: A Colloid of Decay
sections.body: Apothecary Lydon in Tarren Mill seeks to craft a virulent new biological weapon. He sends a composite made from Mudsnout Blossoms north to the Undercity. The toxic mushrooms grow at Nethander Stead, held by gnolls. Master Apothecary Faranell sees promise in the composite and adds his own colloid of decay. The resulting Mudsnout Mixture is volatile. It steadies the mushroom compound and prepares its virulent properties for further catalytic refinement in the foothills.

sections.title: Catalyzing the Agony
sections.body: Mudsnout Mixture needs key catalysts before its contaminating agents can take effect. Faranell sends couriers back to Tarren Mill with the vial, a Strong Troll's Blood Elixir, venomous Daggerspine naga scales, and Torn Fin murloc eyes. Apothecary Lydon catalyzes the mixture with these ingredients to make the lethal Elixir of Agony, a signature poison meant to spread ruin among the Forsaken's living enemies.

faq.q: What is the Mudsnout Mixture used for?
faq.answer: Mudsnout Mixture provides the chemical base for the Elixir of Agony, an experimental poison Apothecary Lydon is perfecting in Tarren Mill to kill the Forsaken's enemies.
Master Apothecary Faranell creates Mudsnout Mixture in the Undercity by adding his colloid of decay to a raw mudsnout composite.

faq.q: Why does it require gnoll components?
faq.answer: Mudsnout Mixture needs no gnoll parts. The composite comes from Mudsnout Blossoms, toxic mushrooms growing at Nethander Stead among the Mudsnout gnolls. Apothecary Lydon blends them into a composite before Faranell adds his colloid of decay.
Apothecary Lydon activates the dormant contaminating agents with a Strong Troll's Blood Elixir, Daggerspine naga scales, and Torn Fin murloc eyes gathered along the Hillsbrad coast.

angles.text: As an undead, you can see the Royal Apothecary Society's ruthless ingenuity at work: wilderness ingredients refined into chemical weapons meant to kill the living.
As a Horde adventurer in Tarren Mill, you carry toxic concoctions across Lordaeron as a courier and field agent, helping secure the Forsaken foothold in Hillsbrad.
